summary: Montenegro's statistics office publishes reported, accused and convicted adults by offence chapter and sex only, with no citizenship or ethnicity and no victim data. The government's trafficking reports could not be downloaded.
european_note: No accessible Montenegrin official source records the ethnicity or citizenship of child victims or perpetrators.
proxy_note: No Montenegrin data by citizenship or ethnicity for child harm were found.

breakdown.why: MONSTAT's 2025 tables give reported, accused and convicted adults by offence chapter and sex only (sexual freedom: 63 reported, 19 convicted); no ethnicity or citizenship, and no victims.
Marriage and family chapter: 831 reported and 311 convicted adults in 2025, by sex only.
Neglect is inside the marriage and family chapter, by sex only.
Life and body chapter: 232 reported and 126 convicted adults in 2025, by sex only.

The government's trafficking documents (gov.me) could not be downloaded from our server (TLS errors and timeouts) and were not worked around. Press reports cite 50 victims in 2025 (36 children) from a government draft, without citizenship; not used for points.
No statistics by citizenship or ethnicity.

components.name: Victim heritage
components.full: Official data by harm that separately identify children of European descent (e.g. White non-Hispanic, White British) alongside every other group, self-reported or official, few unknowns. Broad categories that lump European-descent people with others get partial credit; proxies (nationality, citizenship, migration background, country of birth) at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Perpetrator heritage
components.full: Same standard for perpetrators: not perceived, few unknowns, European descent separately identified. Proxies at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Coverage and missing data
components.full: Over 90% of the population covered, under 10% unknown

components.name: Rates and linkage
components.full: Rates per 100,000 possible, and victim heritage linked to perpetrator heritage

score.gold_standard: 100% means a country publishes data that separately identifies people of European descent, both as perpetrators (so one can tell when they disproportionately harm a group) and as child victims (so one can tell when European-descent children are disproportionately harmed), alongside every other group, linked victim to perpetrator, for every harm.
score.rules: Heritage is 75 of every 100 points (victims 37.5, perpetrators 37.5); coverage, rates and access share the other 25. Proxies such as nationality or migration background earn at most a quarter of the heritage points. A country with no real ethnicity data for victims or perpetrators is capped at 25%.
score.why: Montenegro scores 7% on the stricter scale (0-20%). MONSTAT publishes offenders by offence chapter and sex only, with no ethnicity or citizenship, and the government's trafficking documents could not be downloaded.
score.weights_id: harm weights of 19 Nov 2026 (homicide 25, sexual abuse 20, sex trafficking 20, physical abuse 15, online exploitation 10, neglect 10)
